info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Validation Submission API
info.description: The Document Validation Submission API enables users to submit documents for validation within the banking system. This endpoint allows businesses to ensure that their documents meet the necessary compliance and regulatory standards before proceeding with further transactions. Typically utilized by financial institutions and compliance officers, it facilitates efficient document processing and reduces potential errors. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and maintain regulatory adherence.

post.summary: Submit validations for a specific document.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit validation data for the specified document identified by its unique resource ID. It ensures the document meets required standards and compliance before further processing.

requestBody.description: A payload to validate a document identified by RES-100045. This request body must adhere to the specified schema, which defines the required structure and data types for validation.

200.description: Request completed successfully; the validations are returned.
